title: Laboratory Instructor
description: Delivered weekly structured lessons to students based on a prepared curriculum.
achivements: Successfully delivered lesson materials, enabling students to achieve final scores ranging from 80 to 100.
Successfully created all weekly instructional materials and curriculum content.
Evaluated assignments on schedule, ensuring seamless and timely grade submissions to the Lead Instructor and Laboratory staff.

title: Laboratory Assistant
description: Assisted the Laboratory Instructor in-class by providing hands-on support to students facing difficulties, ensuring smooth and time-efficient learning.
achivements: Provided real-time assistance to struggling students, keeping class sessions running smoothly on schedule.
Graded all weekly student assignments promptly, enabling the Laboratory Instructor to compile and submit final grades on time to the Lead Instructor.

title: Lead Laboratory Instructor
description: Served as Lead Instructor for a practicum course, managing course delivery and compiling final student grades for official submission to laboratory staff.
achivements: Developed the official website for the Informatics Laboratory at Gunadarma University, accessible at iflab.gunadarma.ac.id.
Authored and updated core learning modules to align with the current curriculum.
Managed daily operations and oversight as the designated Laboratory Person-in-Charge (PIC) across campus facilities.
Compiled final student grades accurately and submitted them to designated laboratory staff strictly on schedule.
Served on the committee for recruiting new Laboratory Assistants and Lead Instructors.
